scripts.db:schema: PGPASSWORD="${DB_PASS:?DB_PASS is required}" psql -h "${DB_HOST:?DB_HOST is required}" -p "${DB_PORT:?DB_PORT is required}" -U "${DB_USER:?DB_USER is required}" -d "${DB_NAME:?DB_NAME is required}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: PGPASSWORD="${DB_PASS:?DB_PASS is required}" psql -h "${DB_HOST:?DB_HOST is required}" -p "${DB_PORT:?DB_PORT is required}" -U "${DB_USER:?DB_USER is required}" -d "${DB_NAME:?DB_NAME is required}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v "seed_webhook_secret=${WEBHOOK_SECRET:?WEBHOOK_SECRET is required}" -v "seed_webhook_url=${SEED_WEBHOOK_URL:?SEED_WEBHOOK_URL is required}" -f db/seed.sql
